lines.trans: Glad to see you free again, with a clear conscience.
After all, I was the one who sold her car for a good price.
She had to pay the colonel so that he would release you.
Wait, isn't he an acquaintance of hers?
For that kind of money, he will be your acquaintance too.
I swear, you got lucky with Elena Pavlovna.
Lena, I know everything. Both about the car and about the colonel.

words.gram: nominative neuter singular, used as a noun

lines.trans: I want to come back and work off every kopek.

words.gloss: to work off, earn by working

lines.trans: And then I will buy you a car. May I come back?
You may. Only now as a regular line cook.
As a regular cook it will take me longer to earn enough for your car.
That is alright, I am in no hurry.
